excerpt: From Intern to Employee: Designing Internship Programs That Lead to Full-Time Employment Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. Canada has updated its Temporary Foreign Worker Program (TFWP) by increasing the minimum wage thresholds employers must offer when applying for a Labour Market Impact Assessment (LMIA). These new wage requirements, which came into effect on June 27, 2025, are critical for both employers hiring foreign nationals and workers seeking job opportunities in Canada. This blog explains what has changed, why it matters, and what steps employers and job seekers need
author: Anuj Sengar
